name: Font
description: Represents character formatting for text or a bullet. The Font object is a member of the Fonts collection. The Fonts collection contains all the fonts used in a presentation.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes.Title _

        .TextFrame.TextRange

    .Text = "Volcano Coffee"

    With .Font

        .Italic = True

        .Name = "Palatino"

        .Color.RGB = RGB(0, 0, 255)

    End With

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the current Font object. Read/write.

properties.name: Bold
properties.description: Determines whether the character format is bold. Read/write.

properties.name: Italic
properties.description: True if the font or range is formatted as italic. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Determines whether the specified text has a shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: Emboss
properties.description: Determines whether the character format is embossed. Read/write.

properties.name: Underline
properties.description: Determines whether the specified text (for the Font object) or the font style (for the FontInfo object) is underlined. Read/write.

properties.name: Subscript
properties.description: Determines whether the specified text is subscript. Read/write.

properties.name: Superscript
properties.description: Determines whether the specified text is superscript. Read/write.

properties.name: BaselineOffset
properties.description: Returns or sets the baseline offset for the specified superscript or subscript characters. Read/write.

properties.name: Embedded
properties.description: Determines whether the specified font is embedded in the presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Embeddable
properties.description: Determines whether the specified font can be embedded in the presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets the character size, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: NameFarEast
properties.description: Returns or sets the Asian font name. Read/write.

properties.name: NameAscii
properties.description: Returns or sets the font used for ASCII characters (characters with character set numbers within the range of 0 to 127). Read/write.

properties.name: AutoRotateNumbers
properties.description: Returns or sets lateral compression. Read/write.

properties.name: NameOther
properties.description: Returns or sets the font used for characters whose character set numbers are greater than 127. Read/write.

properties.name: NameComplexScript
properties.description: Returns or sets the complex script font name. Used for mixed language text. Read/write.
